summary: Tested Documents Module and Task Notifications features. Backend: 20/20 tests passed after fixing 3 bugs (route ordering, Form params, delete logic). Frontend: Documents module visible in sidebar, all UI elements working (New Folder dialog, Upload dialog, Grid/List views, stats cards).
seed_data_creation: TEST_Folder_Pytest, TEST_Document.txt created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Documents Module and Task Notifications fully tested. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_documents_notifications.py. All endpoints working: folders CRUD, document upload/download/delete, categories, stats, task notifications (due-soon, overdue, check-and-send).

documents_module_sidebar.details: Documents module appears in sidebar navigation and is accessible

folder_crud.details: Create, Read, Update, Delete folders all working. Color picker with 7 options.

document_upload.details: Upload with category and tags working. Form parameters fixed.

document_list_views.details: Grid and List view modes working with toggle buttons.

document_download.details: Download endpoint returns base64 encoded file content.

document_delete.details: Soft delete (archive) and permanent delete both working after fix.

document_categories.details: Returns 8 predefined categories with English and Arabic names.

document_stats.details: Stats endpoint working after route ordering fix. Returns total_documents, total_size_mb, by_category, by_type, recent_uploads.

task_notifications_due_soon.details: Returns tasks due today, tomorrow, and within 3 days.

task_notifications_overdue.details: Returns overdue tasks sorted by due date.

task_notifications_check_and_send.details: Creates notifications for tasks due today/tomorrow.

api_endpoints_tested: GET /api/documents/stats - Get statistics (PASS - after route fix)
POST /api/documents/upload - Upload document (PASS - after Form fix)
DELETE /api/documents/{id} - Archive document (PASS - after logic fix)

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Route ordering bug - /stats was matched by /{document_id} because dynamic route was defined first
Upload endpoint not receiving form data correctly - category and tags were None
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Changed parameters from Optional[str] = None to Optional[str] = Form(None)

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Delete endpoint returning 520 error due to accessing deleted_count on update_one result
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Separated error handling for permanent delete (deleted_count) vs archive (matched_count)
